correctness.rationale: For 0<a<=2/5, the left/right inverse branches are affine and each shrinks Lebesgue length by 1/2. For a<=1/3 only alternating outer intervals survive; at 1/3<=a<=2/5 the four disjoint B_L,C_L,C_R,B_R blocks form an exact inverse-branch Markov transition with c_{n+1}=c_n/2 and b_{n+1}=(b_n+c_n)/2, initialized by c_1=(3a-1)/2 and b_1=a/2. Inductively m(E_n)=2^-n[2a+2n(3a-1)_+] for every real a and n>=0. Normalized initial law gives the stated tail, hazard and expected entrance time; above 2/5 the formerly forbidden inverse branches add (5a-2)/2 to the n=2 extension, with true mass 6a-2. Both equality parameters are explicitly handled. An independent standard-library exact-rational interval inverse-iteration gave 114 horizon/parameter tests and three upper-range boundary witnesses. The exact all-horizon result rests on the block inclusions/recurrence, not the finite tests.
